0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 4th in the East) in the Magic's fourth game of the season, with Orlando 1-0 on the road and 0-2 at home while Toronto is 1-0 at home and 1-1 on the road. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and Jalen Suggs is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (out, heel surgery), Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet, following a 2025-26 season series in which the Magic lost 1-2 and a March 29, 2026 meeting in Toronto that ended 139-87 for the Raptors.
